body.statement: For every fixed \(t_0\in(0,1/4)\) in the witness submodel, the unique surviving path satisfies \(d_H(S_s,S_t)=2|s-t|\) locally. With \(\widehat t=\{\widehat q_1(1,3)-\widehat q_1(1,1)\}/2\), \[\sqrt n\,d_H(S_{\widehat t},S_{t_0})\Rightarrow2\sqrt{1/4-2t_0^2}\,|N(0,1)|.\] Plug-in folded-normal quantiles give pointwise first-order Hausdorff coverage.
body.justification: The solved one-path stratum verifies that the regular branch is nonvacuous while leaving the multi-path recovery theorem open.
body.gap: Generic nonsmooth-bound asymptotics do not state this explicit rank-policy folded-normal loss law.
body.consumer: The proposition supplies a calibration benchmark and a mandatory regression test for the full loss compiler.
